description.value:
A barbed arrow that hums faintly, as if remembering every wound it has made.

When you hit a creature with an attack using this arrow, the arrow stays lodged in the wound for 1 minute. While it is lodged, whenever the creature takes damage, it takes an extra 2d6 piercing damage as the arrow twists.

The creature can use an action to pull the arrow out with a DC 18 Wisdom (Medicine) check. On a success the arrow comes free and the wound closes; on a failure the wound tears, dealing 4d6 piercing damage, and the arrow stays lodged.

Once it is removed or the minute ends, the arrow crumbles to dust.

midi-qol: An onUse macro on the arrow runs its hidden Lodge activity when the bow's attack hits, applying Echoed Wound to the creature hit. Its isDamaged macro adds the 2d6 (not reduced by resistance) to damage midi applies. While it lasts the creature has a Lodged Arrow item whose Pull Out activity makes the Medicine check.

effects.name: Echoed Wound
effects.description: An arrow is lodged in you: whenever you take damage, you take an extra 2d6 piercing damage. Pull it out with the Lodged Arrow item.

macro.name: Arrow of Echoed Wounds
